column1: # Registered cache roots for disk-guard.sh sweep (W-31 4.6 S1; CUT-lifecycle-2026-10-24.md R8, R9).
# The sweep removes nothing under AGENT_WORK that is not listed here or in
# $AGENT_WORK/status/cache-roots.tsv (the machine's own list: roots a tool or the coordinator
# registered there, e.g. a finished review's cache confirmed by hand).
#   path    relative to AGENT_WORK; * ? [] allowed within a segment, never matching a name with a
#           space, '=' or a quote (register those by their exact name)
#   policy  run.done   the first directory of the path holds run.done (a finished review)
#           ended      the note says who confirmed the owner finished
#           cap=<GiB>  shared root, pruned with the tool's own command above the cap
# The shared caches every review uses (codex exec --add-dir ~/agent-work/.cache; the BRIEF
# exports GOCACHE, GOMODCACHE and npm_config_cache to these three).
